maker: Netscape, then Dave Winer and others
summary: A simple format for publishing a feed of new posts, started by Netscape. Blogs and podcasts were built on it; it faded from view when Google Reader closed, but it still carries every podcast.

icon.licence: CC0 1.0 (the mark itself belongs to its owner)

image.alt: Tiny Tiny RSS, a web feed reader

events.note: Netscape releases RSS 0.9 for its My Netscape portal.

events.label: RSS 1.0
events.note: A working group releases RSS 1.0, based on RDF.

events.label: RSS 2.0
events.note: Dave Winer releases RSS 2.0, "Really Simple Syndication".

events.label: Harvard
events.note: The RSS 2.0 specification is given to Harvard’s Berkman Center.

note: Less visible since Google Reader closed, but still the way podcasts are distributed.
